If I bought a used book or an e-book, that would be better, but even buying a new book isn't necessarily wrong unless it's excessive. Lastly, I reflect on personal values. Putting it all together, buying a book I wanted from the bookstore seems right because it's a responsible use of my money, supports others, and aligns with positive personal values.
